as_told.title: XF-131 design used in the X-Files pilot

plain: A secret aircraft design called the XF-131 appeared in the very first episode of the television series The X-Files in 1993, and the design was allegedly based on true stories from a man named John Duza, also spelled Desouza. An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells this without naming a source. He says that a designer named Bill McDonald was hired to put the craft in the episode, and he credits the show's creator, Chris Carter, which would mean a real secret craft found its way into a TV show.
